subject: Executive Snapshot + Leave-Behind for Aurora Summit — content & logo use review
messages:
From: Emily Jenkins <emily.jenkins@auroraevents.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Summit — exec snapshot + leave-behind request

Hi Lauren,

Great to connect at the partner briefing last week — excited to have Redwood as our Lead AI sponsor for the Aurora Summit. Quick ask to get assets lined up for the sponsor kit and booth leave-behinds:

- Executive snapshot (1 page) summarizing Redwood’s value prop for senior exec attendees (talking points + 2 customer bullets)
- A short leave-behind one-sheet (single page, print-ready) with a small QR to a demo video
- A single-slide demo cue we can use in the sponsor deck (30s script / one-liner)
- Confirmation on logo usage / legal signoff for event materials

Can you share first drafts by EOD Friday (Aug 7)? I attached the current agenda and sponsor specs (Aurora_Agenda_v3.pdf). Also looping Tony from our staging vendor for print size & bleed specs.

Thanks — would like these as deliverables we can hand to our VIP guests on day one.

Best,
Emily Jenkins
Partnerships Manager
Aurora Events
emily.jenkins@auroraevents.com

Attachment: Aurora_Agenda_v3.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Jenkins <emily.jenkins@auroraevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Tony Ramirez <tony@stagingmedia.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Summit — exec snapshot + leave-behind request

Thanks Emily — excited too. Plan below and owners:

- Executive snapshot (1p): Ben will draft content and a visual layout option (v1).
- Leave-behind print sheet: Ben + Tony will iterate on print-safe layout; Tony pls confirm bleed and dielines.
- Demo cue / 30s script: Soojin will draft the script and the single-slide cue.
- Legal/logo use: Marissa, can you confirm what we need for external partner usage and whether we can sign the Aurora sponsor agreement by Fri?

Timing: we’ll circulate a draft PDF by EOD Fri (Aug 7) and a final ready-for-print PDF by Tue Aug 11. If Aurora needs an earlier cut for VIP outreach, let us know and we can prioritize the one-pager first.

Emily — are there any customer quotes you want included (e.g., attendee-friendly language vs technical)? If you can share a preferred line or a quick intro blurb we’ll slot it in.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: exec snapshot + three leave-behind layout options

Hi team — attaching a first-pass PDF: redwood-exec-snapshot-draft.pdf. Quick notes (TL;DR):

- Page 1 (exec snapshot): headline, 2 short customer impact bullets (latency/cost savings + dev time to ship), 3 bullets on deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) in 1-line each.
- Leave-behind variants (A/B/C):
  A) Visual-first: hero stat + quick architecture diagram + QR to demo video
  B) Script-first: 30s talking points + sales cues + callouts for customers
  C) Technical teardown: one-paragraph tech summary + quick perf numbers (for engineering attendees)
- Demo cue slide: I drafted a 30s script option under the slide notes — Soojin pls review voice/timing.

Open questions for Emily/LAUREN/Tony:
1) Which layout do you prefer for VIP handouts (A/B/C)?
2) Any change to the customer blurbs? I used a composite quote placeholder: “Redwood cut our inference costs by 3x while improving p95 latency.”
3) Tony — confirm CMYK vs RGB conversion and safe print margins; I left a 0.125in bleed placeholder.

I’ll stand by for copy edits; if we get signoff on A we can move final to print-ready by Mon Aug 10.

Ben Carter
Senior Content & Events | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-exec-snapshot-draft.pdf

Hi all — quick update from legal/comms:

- Logo usage: approved for Aurora sponsor materials with standard size/clearspace rules. I've attached the signed logo usage form (logo_usage_signed.pdf).
- Copy/legal check: the customer quote placeholder must be attributed or changed to a non-attributed stat; Ben, please modify to: “Customers report up to 3x reduction in inference cost in production.”
- PCI/data language: remove the phrase implying storage of customer PII in hosted logs — replaced with the line "Data is processed per customer tenancy and governance settings."

Ben — I cleaned two tiny copy items in the draft and produced a print-ready final (redwood-exec-snapshot-final.pdf). Tony, please use that file for bleed and final color pass. Emily/Lauren — once Tony confirms print specs we’ll route the final to your print vendor.

Links: Drive folder (assets + final PDFs) -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AEXAMPLE/aurora-summit-assets
DocuSign link for sponsor agreement -> https://docusign.com/XYZ123

Marissa Cole
